pages.text: Create is aesthetic technology — machines that are beautiful to watch, satisfying to build, and genuinely powerful when properly designed.$(br2)Everything runs on $(bold)Rotational Force$(), measured in Stress Units (SU) at a given RPM. Every machine consumes SU; every generator produces it. Exceed supply and the whole network stalls. Balance is the core design loop.

$(bold)Generators:$()$(br)$(bold)Water Wheel$() — place in flowing water. Low output (~256 SU at base speed), but free and always on.$(br)$(bold)Windmill$() — scales with sail count. Large sail arrays hit 8192+ SU. Needs open sky.$(br)$(bold)Steam Engine$() — needs a boiler, water, and heat (lava or blaze burners). High output, real infrastructure cost.

$(bold)Key machines:$()$(br)$(bold)Mechanical Press$() — flatten ingots into sheets, pack items$(br)$(bold)Mechanical Mixer$() — alloys and compound recipes$(br)$(bold)Deployer$() — hands that place or interact with the world$(br)$(bold)Harvester$() — automated crop collection on contraptions$(br)$(bold)Contraptions$() — move entire machines as a unit$(br2)EMI shows all Create recipes. The in-game Create Guidebook (crafted from a book) covers every mechanic in depth.
